correctness.rationale: A physical two-mode state is parity block diagonal. Every normalized pure vector in either two-dimensional parity block is obtained from a Gaussian Fock state by an explicit determinant-one matchgate block, so spectral decomposition makes every physical mixed state convex-Gaussian. The source's parity-preserving unitary plus local depolarization preserves parity superselection. Therefore its written local set-preservation channel property holds for the entire family. At SWAP and \(p=0\), the source's own \(\eta=1\) and Eq. (36) give \(C_+=1\), while it states \(C_-=0\), directly contradicting Eq. (35).
